verdict.rationale: The docs show Kit has email editors that use a saved brand color palette (up to 10 hex codes), which supports on-brand design, and pricing lists collaborative editing. Custom fields capture subscriber data that could drive personalization, but the evidence never describes them as merge tokens. missing for 10: explicit visual drag-and-drop editor documentation, reusable email templates, personalization token syntax/usage, cross-client rendering/preview evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
